```python
import re
from fractions import Fraction

source = (
    "Das Naturdenkmal Čertovy skály ist eine 0,15 ha große durch starke "
    "Wassererosion gezeichnete Sandsteinformation, die in diesem Gebiet "
    "auch als Magura-Flysch bezeichnet wird."
)
translation = (
    "The natural monument of the town is a 0.15 km sand stone information "
    "marked by severe water erosion, which in this area is also referred "
    "to as Magura-Flysch."
)
options = {
    "A": "Modifiers or Adjectives",
    "B": "Numerical Values",
    "C": "Negation or Antonyms",
    "D": "Named Entities",
    "E": "Dropped Content",
    "F": "Facts",
}
submitted = "D"

# Compare the entity occupying the same grammatical position.
source_entity = re.search(r"Naturdenkmal (.*?) ist", source).group(1)
target_entity = re.search(r"natural monument (.*?) is", translation).group(1)
entity_changed = (
    source_entity == "Čertovy skály"
    and source_entity.casefold() not in translation.casefold()
    and target_entity == "of the town"
)
print("Source monument name:", source_entity)
print("Translated identification:", target_entity)
print("Named-entity error:", entity_changed)

# Independently check the quantity; hectares and kilometres are not
# interchangeable units, even though the numerical coefficients match.
source_quantity = re.search(r"(\d+,\d+)\s+(ha)\b", source)
target_quantity = re.search(r"(\d+\.\d+)\s+(km)\b", translation)
source_value = Fraction(source_quantity.group(1).replace(",", "."))
target_value = Fraction(target_quantity.group(1))
source_unit = source_quantity.group(2)
target_unit = target_quantity.group(2)
dimensions = {"ha": "area", "km": "length"}
unit_error = dimensions[source_unit] != dimensions[target_unit]

print("Source quantity:", source_value, source_unit)
print("Target quantity:", target_value, target_unit)
print("Additional numerical/unit error:", unit_error)

print("Submitted option:", submitted, options[submitted])
if submitted == "D" and entity_changed:
    print("CHECK PASS: the submitted category identifies an actual error.")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL: the submitted category is not supported.")

if entity_changed and unit_error:
    print(
        "UNSUPPORTED: a unique error category cannot be established; "
        "the text also supports (B) Numerical Values."
    )
```
